# Memory Graph

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A structured network of entities (nodes) and their relationships (edges), typically machine-readable, used to represent and query interconnected short-term and long-term memory.

## Scope note

- Important for services and agents.

## Broader

- [Graph Database](../GraphDatabase/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
